description: pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs:425 — eku.0.iter().any(|oid| oid == &ID_KP_SERVER_AUTH) is the manual equivalent of eku.0.iter().any(|oid| oid == &ID_KP_SERVER_AUTH). Since x509_cert's ObjectIdentifier implements PartialEq, the idiomatic form is eku.0.contains(&ID_KP_SERVER_AUTH). The same pattern occurs in chain_walk in pkix-path/src/lib.rs. Minor clippy-style finding.
title: EkuServerAuthLint uses iter().any(|oid| oid == &CONST) instead of contains
